scope: All36 original T07 supplemental criteria, their36 transfers and LSYS-EXEC-T07; historical snapshots retained.

criteria.task: Write step.c containing int step(int x){return 3*x+BIAS;} and main.c declaring step and returning step(4)!=19; supply cfg.h defining BIAS as 7. Produce separate .i, .s, .o and final executable using explicit stages with cfg.h included only in step.c. Record every producer and exit status.

ordinary_observation.claim: Separate preprocessor/compiler/assembler/linker products and missing-symbol link rejection

transfer_observation.claim: Assembly _start establishes call alignment, passes argument and exits through Linux syscall; no CRT supplied

criteria.task: Retain step.i, change cfg.h to BIAS 9, and compile both the retained .i and a freshly preprocessed .c. Identify where the old value remains and attach the first differing artifact.

ordinary_observation.claim: Frozen .i retains old generated macro despite fresh source/header inputs

transfer_observation.claim: Generated selected header changed7→9 and both C timestamps refreshed; retained .i still computes19 while fresh source computes21

criteria.task: Capture the actual driver's subprocesses for the two-TU program; reconstruct them with identical target, startup files, search paths and final link inputs. Compare behavior and explain any file-byte differences with section-level evidence.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual GCC link subprocess reconstructed for PIE and static, with selected startup/library inputs

transfer_observation.claim: Static changes runtime closure; PIE changes loader and image assumptions

criteria.task: Create an artifact manifest for native x86-64 Linux and compile-only Arm32 probes. Record target triple, ISA options, data model and object ABI separately; reject a mislabeled artifact before attempting execution.

ordinary_observation.claim: Native/Arm artifact manifest verifies class, endianness and machine before any execution

transfer_observation.claim: Same Cortex-M4 instruction support, actual softfp/hard attributes and incompatible-link rejection

criteria.task: For the stage program capture compiler -v/-### and search-directory output; resolve each selected startup object and library to a path and hash. Run an independent clean directory build with a deliberately missing local library.

ordinary_observation.claim: Resolved startup/library hashes, search paths and specific missing-local-library rejection

transfer_observation.claim: Only selected target library root changes while compiler/consumer object stay fixed; changed dependency and image hashes invalidate old closure conclusions
evidence: foreign second-root commands and identity controls

criteria.task: Provide a host generator that reads the ASCII file VALUE=7 and writes cfg.h, plus a target object consuming it. Mark every executable as host-runnable or target-only and retain configuration commands proving the target was never run.

ordinary_observation.claim: Separate compiled host C generator creates input to target-only Arm compilation

transfer_observation.claim: Host C generator remains explicitly separate from non-native application compiler

criteria.task: Create three isolated TUs: valid unsigned addition, unused parameter, and assignment to a const int. Define a GCC/Clang C17 policy that distinguishes accepted, expected-warning and required-diagnostic cases; add a signed-overflow example as analysis-only.

ordinary_observation.claim: Tool-specific warning and C17 constraint are separate; signed-overflow reasoning is assessor-only

transfer_observation.claim: GCC and Clang diagnostic classes checked without depending on complete prose

criteria.task: Implement a compile-case runner that records command, positive control, diagnostic class and exit status for those three TUs. Inject a nonexistent compiler path and a missing include into the negative case.

ordinary_observation.claim: Valid control, language diagnostic, missing header, missing compiler and link-only failure classified distinctly

transfer_observation.claim: Compile-only link-negative is accepted as a translation but rejected at final link

criteria.task: Use GCC diagnostic push/ignored/pop around one justified unused-parameter shim; put another unused parameter outside the region and require its warning. Document the shim's API ownership and why the source cannot simply omit it.

ordinary_observation.claim: Region and TU-local suppressions preserve unrelated diagnostics

transfer_observation.claim: Target-local suppression cannot suppress a separately compiled TU

criteria.task: Compare O0/O2/Os code for a bounded uint32_t sum over at most 16 values, using exact-width modulo semantics and a mathematical modulo oracle. Annotate changed loop/inlining code and record size separately from behavior.

ordinary_observation.claim: GCC/Clang O0/O2/Os sums n=0..16 agree with independent integer oracle; disassembly and size retained

transfer_observation.claim: Disjoint-buffer restrict transfer executes; overlapping modifying access is analyzed separately with no portable golden output

criteria.task: Create distinct build directories/presets for debug, sanitizer, release and size. Change one preset's flags, retain compilation commands, and show its objects cannot be reused from another profile.

ordinary_observation.claim: Six isolated effective-flag configurations, active NDEBUG control, host-only coverage/sanitizer dependencies

transfer_observation.claim: Coverage links its own host runtime; target closure is not inferred

criteria.task: For the same sum and an aggregate-copy probe compare undefined symbols, linked objects and final dynamic dependencies in O0/O2/LTO and sanitizer builds. Classify each new helper as target-allowed, host-only or unsupported.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual sum+1024-byte copy object/final closure for O0/O2/Os/LTO/sanitizer/coverage; bitcode reader explicit

transfer_observation.claim: Custom-entry stack protection requires support symbol and initialized guard contract; bare link refuses missing support

criteria.task: Build schema.txt -> cfg.h -> step.o -> executable, with independent main.o. Write the graph before recipes; use compiler-generated header dependencies and preserve a generation log. Delete cfg.h after a successful build.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual depfile graph, independent main TU, header-deletion regeneration

transfer_observation.claim: One grouped producer publishes two coherent headers before any parallel consumer
limitations: Grouped Make scheduling is not a transaction for unrelated readers or sudden power loss.

criteria.task: Create build/ as an order-only prerequisite, cfg.h as an ordinary prerequisite and clean as phony. Touch each separately and predict rebuilds from Make's graph and timestamps before observing them.

ordinary_observation.claim: Order-only directory versus ordinary header invalidation and phony actions

transfer_observation.claim: Broken order-only cfg edge yields stale7; repairing ordinary edge yields9

criteria.task: Exercise fresh build, no-op, header edit, header deletion, generator edit and unrelated-file edit. Record expected and actual rebuilt target sets and repair one omitted edge; force the generator to fail before publication.

ordinary_observation.claim: Fresh/no-op/schema/deletion/generator/unrelated/failure recovery observed; exact rebuild sets checked

transfer_observation.claim: Same-time changed bytes defeat timestamp freshness; hash mismatch invalidates then rebuilds
limitations: This conservative digest policy scans full input bytes and rebuilds affected graph; hashing is not free or provenance authentication.

criteria.task: Generate cfg.h from VALUE=7 before compiling step.c. Make configuration probes depend on generated inputs only when logically required; trace configure and build phases and force generator failure.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual configure and build owners, failure propagation and preserved generated outputs

transfer_observation.claim: Build-time custom command explicitly owns generated headers and input edges

criteria.task: Embed the exact bytes 00 7F 80 FF from a four-byte resource in a generated header. Change, truncate and delete the input; verify emitted length and unsigned byte values against an independent hex decoder.

ordinary_observation.claim: Exact high-bit/zero bytes, changes, truncation, empty ISO array representation and missing input rejection

transfer_observation.claim: Ordered manifest distinguishes reorder from equal unordered file set

criteria.task: Configure a compile-only foreign target with explicit feature answers and CMake STATIC_LIBRARY try-compile where appropriate. Supply a host generator separately and record every executed program.

ordinary_observation.claim: STATIC_LIBRARY target try-compile establishes pointer width; no accidental target execution

transfer_observation.claim: Explicit QEMU lm3s6965evb Cortex-M3 run, original semihost output/exit and final-image closure
limitations: Semihost calls are emulator/host services; not admitted in a board-runtime closure or evidence of physical peripherals.

criteria.task: Build libraries Tiny and Support; Tiny's public header uses a declared layout macro, while its implementation calls Support. List compile requirements and final link requirements separately for Tiny and a consumer.

ordinary_observation.claim: Tiny static unresolved Support call closes at final consumer link; public layout is independently propagated
evidence: packages source, exported configs, compile databases and commands

transfer_observation.claim: Support shared variant changes actual final DT_NEEDED closure

criteria.task: Assign PRIVATE/PUBLIC/INTERFACE to Tiny implementation includes, public layout macro and header-only interface requirements. Build two consumers with conflicting private helper names to expose accidental leakage.

ordinary_observation.claim: Two consumers retain different private helper values; deliberate private-path leak gives intended wrong result
evidence: packages source, exported configs, compile databases and commands

transfer_observation.claim: Making support_value public changes the transitive include/link contract

criteria.task: Install Tiny::tiny and its dependency description into prefix A; copy only installed files to prefix B, configure a separate consumer with no producer-tree search paths, then inspect generated package files for private absolute paths.

ordinary_observation.claim: Installed exported targets consumed from relocated prefix without producer-tree search paths
evidence: packages source, exported configs, compile databases and commands

transfer_observation.claim: Support separately relocated and resolved by explicit find_dependency

criteria.task: Use Ninja's explanation/debug output for schema/header/source/command-line changes; predict each rebuilt target before running. Include a compile-flag-only change with unchanged source timestamps.

ordinary_observation.claim: Depfile and command-line invalidation actually observed; graph/deps saved

transfer_observation.claim: main.c and ./main.c graph spellings compared without assuming universal path normalization

criteria.task: Generate compile_commands.json for two configurations of one source file. Parse directory, file, arguments or command, and optional output; preserve both entries rather than choosing the first silently.

ordinary_observation.claim: Two configuration/output identities retained; link and generation deliberately absent from compdb

transfer_observation.claim: Spaced macro stays one argument in explicit arguments array

criteria.task: Replay one selected translation unit from its recorded working directory using the exact argument vector after separately generating prerequisites. Record object and command hashes and compare with the front-end build.

ordinary_observation.claim: Exact cwd/argv replay reconstructs each object under same inputs

transfer_observation.claim: Stale root database fails at missing old input; regenerated database addresses relocated tree

criteria.task: Write a compile-only toolchain manifest containing compiler path/version, target triple, sysroot, linker script and target library inventory. Remove one required target library in a copied test sysroot and demand visible failure.

ordinary_observation.claim: Actual target link scripts/library inventory and missing target library rejection; no host substitution

transfer_observation.claim: Changing only memory map changes linked placement, not input object bytes

criteria.task: Make host and target directories contain intentionally different tiny.h and libtiny.a names plus one host generator. Set CMake find-root modes explicitly and log every resolved path.

ordinary_observation.claim: Host generator and same-named target header/library selected under explicit root modes; contamination diagnosed before execution

transfer_observation.claim: Nested Outer→Inner package discovery remains in target root

criteria.task: Cross-compile a simple float add for compatible and incompatible Arm32 floating-point ABI settings, inspect attributes/disassembly and attempt only safe link checks. Record absent toolchain profiles as unavailable.

ordinary_observation.claim: Arm compatible and incompatible fixed-prototype ABI objects inspected and safely linked

transfer_observation.claim: Variadic double argument is consumed using base PCS even for hard-float build; conversion helper/stack instructions retained
limitations: Compile observation plus AAPCS32 rule; no Arm execution inferred.

criteria.task: Create a local dependency package of two small original source files, a version label and SHA256 manifest. Corrupt one byte, rename a version without changing content and omit one file; verify all inputs before building.

ordinary_observation.claim: Corrupt/missing files rejected; renamed version label separated from content identity

transfer_observation.claim: Generator/config/output all pinned; configuration change rejected

criteria.task: Build the same Tiny API from separately prepared system-style prefix, vendored source and prepopulated fetched-source cache. Compare provenance, update ownership and reproducibility under one explicit correctness contract.

ordinary_observation.claim: Same API actually built from prefix archive, vendored source and prepopulated FetchContent source

transfer_observation.claim: Same-version patched vendored bytes do not pass original manifest

criteria.task: Populate a local cache, then perform a clean build using only declared local paths with fetch disabled in the build configuration. Delete one cache entry and require a deterministic missing-input failure; do not alter host network settings.

ordinary_observation.claim: Explicit local-source disconnected clean build; missing cache input fails without network fallback

transfer_observation.claim: Transitive Support change/absence violates complete cache manifest

criteria.task: Register a pure unit case, two-component integration case, expected diagnostic case and target-only case. Model PASS, FAIL and UNAVAILABLE separately and inject a broken compiler invocation.

ordinary_observation.claim: Unit/integration/diagnostic/target registration separates execution scope and broken-compiler failure

transfer_observation.claim: Named emulator result is separate from unavailable physical cell

criteria.task: Define GCC/Clang by O0/O2 with one native target and one compile-only foreign target. State which cells can execute, compare identical semantic contracts and retain the first divergence rather than majority voting.

ordinary_observation.claim: GCC/Clang O0/O2 native cells execute; Arm GCC/Clang cells compile only under explicit target contracts

transfer_observation.claim: LTO cells actually rebuild and inspect final closure; no native result fills foreign execution

criteria.task: For a deliberately failing assertion retain the exact source revision, command, binary hash, stderr and environment; reproduce the failure from those records in a fresh local directory. Redact unrelated environment values.

ordinary_observation.claim: Exact source/header/argv/binary/diagnostic receipt reproduces marked failure in fresh directory

transfer_observation.claim: Header-only changed bytes invalidate prior binary receipt

criteria.task: Build the stage program with debug information and __FILE__ in two temporary source roots. Add a generator timestamp explicitly, then identify path, time, archive order and build-ID contributions separately.

ordinary_observation.claim: Path, generated-time, debug and build-ID contributions retained; normalized input policy reproduces exactly

transfer_observation.claim: Deterministic archives retain ordering; duplicate definition extraction changes actual exit1/2

criteria.task: Compare full binary hashes first, then section contents, debug metadata and declared semantic output for the two-root builds. Explain each difference rather than declaring all unequal bytes defects.

ordinary_observation.claim: Whole-file, text, debug and declared computation are separately compared; output metadata remains observable

transfer_observation.claim: Generated table order changes first-match result; normalization would hide actual semantic defect

criteria.task: Write a provenance record binding source hashes, generated inputs, compiler/linker versions, effective flags, dependency hashes and output hashes for one clean build. Change one input and reject reuse of the old record.

ordinary_observation.claim: Provenance binds sources/generated header/tool identity/flags/driver inputs/output and rejects changed input

transfer_observation.claim: Different GCC/Clang implementations agree on declared computation but not binary identity
limitations: This is a compiler-family change, not a second GCC release. The learner must redo the release-specific comparison if claiming that narrower variant.
